Verbum Domini quod factum est: The word of the Lord, that came
The beginning of the Lord’s speaking by Osee
PRINCIPIUM LOQUENDI DOMINO IN OSEE: The beginning of the Lord’s speaking by Osee
Et dixit Dominus ad Osee:: and the Lord said to Osee
Vade, sume tibi uxorem fornicationum: Go, take thee a wife of fornications
et fac filios fornicationis: and have of her children of fornications
Et abiit et accepit Gomer filiam Debelai: So he went and took Gomer, the daughter of Debelaim: and she conceived, and bore him a son
Et dixit Dominus ad eum: Voca nomen eius: And the Lord said to him: Call his name Jezrahel
quoniam adhuc modicum et visitabo sangui: for yet a little while, and I will visit the blood of Jezrahel
conteram arcum: I will break in pieces the bow
And she conceived again, and bore a daughter
Et dixit ei: Voca nomen eius Absque mise: and he said to him: Call her name, Without mercy: for I will not add any more to have mercy on the house of Israel, but I will utterly forget them
Et domui Iuda miserebor et salvabo eos i: And I will have mercy on the house of Juda, and I will save them by the Lord, their God
ET DOMUI IUDA: And I will have mercy on the house of Juda
et non salvabo eos in arcu: and I will not save them by bow
Et ablactavit eam que erat Absque miseri: And she weaned her that was called Without mercy
erit numerus filiorum Israel quasi arena: the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea
that is without measure, and shall not be numbered
ET ERIT IN LOCO: And it shall be in the place
Non populus meus vos dicetur eis filii D: You are not my people: it shall be said to them: Ye are the sons of the living God
filii Iuda et filii Israel: the children of Juda, and the children of Israel
ET CONGREGABUNTUR FILII IUDA: And the children of Juda … shall be gathered together
quoniam ipsa non uxor mea et ego non vir: because she is not my wife, and I am not her husband
AUFERAT FORNICATIONES: Let her put away her fornications
Auferat fornicationes suas a facie sua e: Let her put away her fornications from her face, and her adulteries from between her breasts
ne forte expoliem eam nudam et statuam e: Lest I strip her naked, and set her as in the day that she was born
ET PONAM EAM QUASI: and I will make her as
et statuam eam velut terram inviam: and will set her as a land that none can pass through
Quia fornicata est mater eorum, confusa: For their mother hath committed fornication … is covered with shame
quia dixit: Vadam post amatores meos: for she said: I will go after my lovers
Propter hoc ecce ego sepiam viam tuam sp: Wherefore, behold, I will hedge up thy way with thorns, and I will stop it up with a wall
and she shall not find her paths
ET SEQUETUR AMATORES: And she shall follow after her lovers
et queret eos et non inveniet: and she shall seek them, and shall not find
et revertar ad virum meum priorem: and return to my first husband
quia mihi bene erat tunc: because it was better with me then
they have used in the service of Baal
QUE FECERUNT BAAL: which they have used in the service of Baal
Idcirco convertar et sumam frumentum meu: Therefore will I return, and take away my corn
LIBERABO LANAM MEAM: I will set at liberty my wool
revelabo stultitiam eius in oculis amato: I will lay open her folly in the eyes of her lovers
ET NUNC REVELABO: And now I will lay open
and no man shall deliver her out of my hand
Et cessare faciam omne gaudium eius,: And I will cause all her mirth to cease
sabbatum eius et omnia festa tempora eiu: her sabbaths, and all her festival times
Et corrumpam vineam eius et ficum eius d: And I will destroy her vines, and her fig trees, of which she said
super eam dies Baalim: upon her the days of Baalim
et ornabant inaure sua et monili suo et: and decked herself out with her earrings, and with her jewels, and went after her lovers
Propter hoc ecce ego lactabo eam: Therefore, behold I will allure her
Et dabo ei vinitores eius ex eodem loco: And I will give her vinedressers out of the same place
ad aperiendam spem et canet ibi iuxta di: for an opening of hope: and she shall sing there according to the days of her youth, and according to the days of her coming up out of the land of Egypt
Et erit in die illo ait Dominus:: And it shall be in that day, saith the Lord
ET ERIT IN DIE: And it shall be in that day
Vocabit me Vir meus et non vocabit me ul: she shall call me: My husband, and she shall call me no more Baali
Et percutiam eis fedus in die illo, cum: And in that day I will make a covenant with them, with the beasts of the field
et cum volucre celi et cum reptili terre: and with the fowls of the air, and with the creeping things of the earth: and I will destroy the bow, and the sword, and war
and I will make them sleep secure
Et sponsabo te mihi in sempiternum: And I will espouse thee to me for ever
et sponsabo te mihi in iustitia: and I will espouse thee to me in justice
Et erit in die illa:: And it shall come to pass in that day
Et exaudiam, dicit Dominus, et exaudiam: I will hear, saith the Lord, I will hear the heavens
and they shall hear the earth
Et terra exaudiet triticum et vinum et o: And the earth shall hear the corn, and the wine, and the oil, and these shall hear Jezrahel
Et seminabo eam mihi in terram: And I will sow her unto me in the earth
et miserebor eius que fuit Absque miseri: and I will have mercy on her that was without mercy
Et dicam Non populo meo: Populus meus es: And I will say to that which is not my people: Thou art my people
shall say: Thou art my God
Et dixit Dominus ad me: Adhuc vade et di: And the Lord said to me: Go yet again, and love a woman beloved of her friend, and an adulteress
sicut diligit Dominus filios Israel et i: as the Lord loveth the children of Israel, and they look to strange gods, and love the husks of the grapes
Et fodi eam mihi: And I bought her to me
quindecim argenteis et coro ordei: for fifteen pieces of silver, and for a core of barley
and for half a core of barley
Et dixit ad eam: Diebus multis: And I said to her: … many days
me, non fornicaberis: for me: thou shalt not play the harlot
et non eris viro, sed et ego exspectabo: and thou shalt be no man’s, and I also will wait for thee
et sine sacrificio et sine altari: and without sacrifice, and without altar
Et post hec revertentur filii Israel: And after this the children of Israel shall return
et querent Dominum Deum suum: and shall seek the Lord, their God
et pavebunt ad Dominum: and they shall fear the Lord
and his goodness, in the last days
